source: live getComputedStyle on sok.riksarkivet.se (1440x900 / 390x844 @2x), CSS bundles fetched in-browser (main-extern, bootstrap, uv.css), network log; cookies = necessary only. Search results / archive card pages are behind ALTCHA and were NOT captured.

type_scale.note: no modular scale: practically 14 / 16.8 / 20 / 32 px; Bootstrap 2 era

colors.viewer_bg: #000 stage (body bg #0B151F), right info panel #212121 with white text, top bar and buttons dark grey (exact value not measured)

layout.container: Bootstrap 2 container-fluid, content 940px wide centered (x=250..1190 at 1440), main padding 0 6px

header.parts: top utility row (Sign in, Other languages dropdown, Riksarkivet, Webbutiken links) + crest/wordmark logo + subtitle 'Search the collections'; below: navbar 63px with 6px #0D5C91 top rule

layout.nav: 4 tabs: START | DIGITAL RESEARCH ROOM | NATIONAL ARCHIVES DATABASE | ABOUT THE SEARCH SERVICE; active tab measured 136x56 with gold bottom bar; 14px uppercase
layout.footer: height 230px, padding 40px 20px, white bg, text columns: address (Box 7223), contact, About the search service, Image viewer, FAQs, Cookies, personal data, accessibility

components.search_panel: on every page: panel #E9F0F5, padding 20px, shadow 0 1px 2px; serif heading 'Search' (#2D4156-ish blue, hairline under, 'Search tips' link right), single text input 569px x 30px (border #CCC radius 4), two checkboxes ('Digitised material only', 'Transcribed material only BETA' with info icons), buttons Search (#0D5C91, 12px 32px, magnifier icon) + Clear (#E8A621, x icon), 'More options' (advanced) link
components.search_tabs: Bootstrap nav-tabs on search pages: Digital Research Room | Topics | Special search | A-O | Free text | Archive | Image id; active tab white with 5px #184B7E top border
components.home_cards: white cards, shadow 0 1px 2px, padding 20px, title Roboto 500 32px, then stack of full-width gold link-buttons (h 41px, bg #E8A621, black text 14px, chevron right) e.g. 'Digital Research Room', 'Databases (Church archives, Census etc.)', 'Topics'; right aside card #EEE with 'Order copies or research'
components.list_new_volumes_table: /nytt-material: zebra table, columns Arkiv | Volymens referenskod | Tid | Publicerad + green 'Bild' button (55x37) -> opens viewer; summary 'Visar traff 1 - 100 av 193'; sort select + pagination (|<  <  1 2  >  >|, 31px high cells, grey)
components.hierarchy: flat: Arkiv (fond) -> Serie -> Referenskod SE/RA/1135/VII/3/621 -> Datering; shown as labelled rows in the viewer info panel; archive card page itself behind captcha (could not capture)
components.language_switch: 'Other languages' dropdown in utility row -> sv / en (cookie lang=sv-SE; ?Sprak=Engelska) ; page.html lists other languages
components.viewer: Universal Viewer (UV) self-hosted at /universalviewer/lib/uv.js + uv.css, Riksarkivet fork (GitHub Riksarkivet/universalviewer4, uv-sv-SE-theme, uv-custom); OpenSeadragon inside (.openseadragon-container + 2 canvas); layout: black stage, top bar 40px with crest/logo left, centre controls [|< -5 < (select 'Bild 5') > +5 >|] and gear right; title line 20px white (truncated with ellipsis); left-top tools + - home rotate contrast; side arrows prev/next; bottom-left print/download; bottom-right fullscreen; minimap navigator bottom-right; right collapsible panel 'MER INFORMATION' (255px, #212121): OM OBJEKTET: Arkiv, Serie, Referenskod, Datering, Kallhanvisning (citation, 'mer'), Rattigheter (CC PDM 1.0 link), IIIF-manifest URL; SIDA: Bildid, Lank, Kallhanvisning; mobile: toolbar collapses to bottom icon row + (i) info button
components.captcha: ALTCHA ('Verifiera att du ar manniska' / 'Jag ar inte en robot' checkbox, 'Protected by ALTCHA') shown instead of any /?Sokord=, /nad?..., /?postid=..., /arkiv/<id> request from an automated browser; bildvisning/*, /nytt-material, /a-o, /digitala-forskarsalen, /en/nad/ were open

motion.skeleton: none; server-rendered pages, viewer shows black stage until tiles arrive

stack.css: Bootstrap 2.x (span8, container-fluid, btn-navbar, row-fluid) + jQuery UI + jquery-treeview + FontAwesome 3.0.1
stack.cookie_consent: own cookieconsent bundle (ra_cookie_settings cookie, levels necessary/analytics)
github: https://github.com/Riksarkivet (forks: universalviewer, universalviewer4, openseadragon, uv-sv-SE-theme, uv-custom, iiif-metadata-component; plus ra-sokprototyper, dataplattform, iiif-net)
stack.open_data: https://sok.riksarkivet.se/data-api (downloadable datasets, e.g. 'Aktiebolag 1901-1935'), CC PDM rights on scans
